text:
Asha K: quick sync  RN PR is up (https://git.redwood/release-notes/PR-499). Planning a soft EU-focused canary at 09:00 PT (16:00 CET) then global canary at 09:30 PT. Need the internal announce copy and pinned artifact.

Liam G: artifact: `redwood-infer:1.11.0-eu`. Pin command for ops: `./deployctl pin --service infer --image redwood-infer:1.11.0-eu --scope eu,hosted`

Nina: drafting announce: "Soft launch (EU) of inference runtime 1.11.0. Canary 16:00 CET (09:00 PT) -> 20% at 16:15 CET -> global canary 09:30 PT. Oncall: @Liam G. Rollback trigger/command included." Add note for Dedicated customers re: config toggle.

ops-bot: Capacity reserve executed for pool infer-eu at 15:45 CET. Reserved +35% headroom.

deploy-bot: Preflight scheduled at 15:50 CET (09:50 PT). Checks: kernel compatibility, quant-smoke, license. Will post results.

Nina: also include one-line impact expectations: "Expected: no user-visible downtime; token-level latency change <+10% during canary."

Liam G: rollback command (ops):
```
# immediate rollback to previous stable
./deployctl rollback --service infer --to stable-1.10.6 --region eu
```

deploy-bot: Preflight results: PASS. Warning: AVX variant mismatch on eu-nodepool-3 (non-blocking). Recommend monitor evictions.

EUInfra: noted the warning. We'll watch node evictions and trigger autoscaler if needed.

Asha K: final checklist before internal announce at 08:45 PT: (1) RN copy approved, (2) pin verified, (3) preflight pass (ok), (4) oncall assigned. If green we open soft EU canary at 09:00 PT.

Liam G: +1. I'll be actively monitoring p50/p95 and error-rate. Rollback thresholds: p95 +50% sustained 5m or errors >2% for 3m.

Nina: posting internal announce now to all-eng and eu-ops. Short copy includes PR link and rollback command.

Asha K: thanks all  please post status updates at 09:10 PT and 09:30 PT. If any abnormal spikes, call the rollback command and ping #incidents.
